dedupe_keys.name: gloucp a global 1 km spatially continuous urban canopy parameters for the wrf model

description: The GloUCP research team publishes global urban-canopy parameters for the WRF model at 1 km resolution around 2020. The parameters are derived from the 3D-GloBFP building-footprint dataset and packaged into 288 geographic tiles using WRF geogrid binary files. Additional GeoTIFFs supply impervious-surface fractions and a binary mask derived from GAIA, with a threshold of 0.01. Figshare version 3 provides public, free access under CC-BY-4.0. The description gives 255 one-degree files per nominal 15-by-15-degree package, an apparent count inconsistency that remains unresolved. Derived building geometry and threshold choices introduce uncertainty for local urban form. The fields can initialise WRF urban-climate simulations and support infrastructure heat-exposure assessment. They complement source building footprints by translating geometry into model parameters. A download-and-merge application is also listed, but its executable was not obtained or run.
name: GloUCP: A global 1 km spatially continuous urban canopy parameters for the WRF model.
